Coke Studio Season 11| Episode 6
Song Name: Hawa Hawa
A star from 80’s Pakistani music and an age-old folk tune turned Pakistani pop chart-topper, gets revived with Hassan Jahangir’s classic rock star vibes and Gul Panrra's sweet voice! With percussion-driven Balochi Lewa beats this nostalgic remix will become a favorite in the desi dance songs of 2018 and definitely be one of the top trending songs of Coke studio 11.
